about:
Fabrication Syndicate operates in Las Vegas, Nevada, where a team of fabricators came together to build a shop capable of handling any project from start to finish. The business traces its roots to owner Scott Carter, who began working with metal at age 17 in Southern California before establishing the Las Vegas operation. A second owner, Mike, is also noted in customer feedback.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication with a focus on steel and aluminum welding, using a Millermatic 252 MIG welder for steel and a Miller Syncrowave 210 TIG welder for aluminum and stainless steel. Cutting is performed on an Arclight Dynamics 4'x8' CNC plasma table equipped with a tubing attachment for precise copes and miters, plus CNC engraving capability. Tube bending is handled by a hydraulic bender with a degree wheel and dedicated tube-bending software. In-house powder coating adds finish options. The facility also houses a 2-post 10,000 lb vehicle lift to support automotive fabrication such as lift kits, suspension work, and performance engine builds. Output ranges from dog cages, fish tank stands, and custom furniture to full custom vehicle builds.

Customers span automotive enthusiasts seeking suspension modifications or engine swaps, homeowners needing custom furniture or decorative metalwork, and pet or aquarium owners requiring specialized stands and cages. The shop serves both individual consumers and small commercial clients looking for one-off or low-volume metalwork.

The company emphasizes advanced CAD software for design through production, modern equipment to maintain precision, and a shop culture that includes a vehicle lift for ergonomic automotive work. They position themselves as a single-source provider able to take a project from concept to finished, powder-coated product.
